_about: Cold Clear evaluation weights. Every field here is the library default; edit and pass with --weights config/weights.json. Positive = reward, negative = penalty. Delete a key to keep the default.
_stack: bumpiness/height/row_transitions shape the surface; top_half/top_quarter escalate as the stack rises; cavity=holes, covered=cells above holes, overhang=cells resting on nothing
_wells: well_depth rewards a single deep well (capped at max_well_depth); well_column is the preference for which column holds it, left to right
_clears: clear1..clear4 = reward per line-clear size; tspin*/mini_tspin* = T-spin rewards; b2b_clear = back-to-back bonus; combo_garbage = sustaining a combo; wasted_t = T placed without spinning
_tslot: reward for having a T-spin slot available, indexed by how good the setup is
_garbage: jeopardy scales fear of incoming garbage (needs the garbage meter reader); timed_jeopardy weights it by how soon it lands
